data.title: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks
data.description: Detect anomalous CNAME record density where hundreds or thousands of apparently unrelated domains share CNAME chains terminating at a small number of infrastructure endpoints. Indicates centrally managed infrastructure reusing cloud or CDN providers for mass domain hosting.

enrichment_required.source: DNS analytics enrichment (CNAME chain depth calculation)
DNS analytics enrichment (CNAME chain endpoint count)
DNS analytics enrichment (unique domain count aggregation)

falsepositives: Legitimate marketing platforms with many customer domains
